articles.summary: In 1987, a newspaper ad caught the eye of a physics professor in Sydney. It was a call to adventure: build a car powered only by the sun and race it 3,000 kilometers across the Australian Outback. That professor was John Storey— and nearly four decades later, Storey is still at the heart of the Bridgestone World Solar Challenge.
